summary: The plugin has a valid manifest but its installer executes unverified remote content. Installation is not recommended.

findings.title: Installer executes unverified remote content
findings.explanation: Remote content is piped directly to a shell with no pin, checksum, or signature.
findings.impact: Arbitrary code execution with the user's permissions inside the Omarchy session.
findings.action: Do not install; require a pinned, verified installer.

findings.title: Credential directory referenced
findings.explanation: The update helper packages the user's SSH directory without a documented need.
findings.impact: Potential credential theft if the archive leaves the machine.
findings.action: Remove the credential access and explain any legitimate need.

findings.title: Camera access could not be inspected
findings.action: Re-run with the user session available if camera behavior matters.

malware_indicators: LSC-001 is consistent with an unverified payload; no packed binaries were found.
permissions: No unexpected SUID binaries or sudo rules were found in the inspected scope.
network_privacy: No microphone or camera capture was attributed during the audit.

actions.action: Ask the author for a pinned installer with checksums.
